title: Stability of the constant negative function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $f$ be the constant function equal to $-1$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its noise stability at correlation $\rho$—the expectation of $f(X)f(Y)$ when $(X,Y)$ is a $[?]$ pair with the correlated sign distribution—is $1$.
caveat: The correlated-pair distribution is specified by the supplied definitions, but describing it informally here would require restating that construction.
